title: Poll-based ingestion, EMSA originates all sends
body: EMSA polls the LMS Aurora read replica (learntastic_ro) for state and originates all sends itself. It does not depend on any push/event pipeline from the LMS.

attributes.statement: EMSA polls the LMS Aurora read replica (learntastic_ro) for state and originates all sends itself. It does not depend on any push/event pipeline from the LMS.
attributes.rationale: The fleet is heterogeneous (Laravel + WordPress brands). A push-relay model requiring a distributable Laravel package could never cover WordPress brands, forcing either N per-stack clients or permanent Brevo dependence for non-Laravel brands.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Push/relay model (MIRA composer package installed per sending brand, pushes rendered email to EMSA /api/v1/send)
alternatives_rejected.reason: Structurally incapable of covering non-Laravel brands in the fleet
